principle_violations.reason: The UserService class has responsibilities related to user management as well as direct database operations, making it harder to maintain and test.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the database operations into a dedicated class or interface to adhere to the Single Responsibility Principle, which will make the UserService class focused solely on user business logic.

principle_violations.reason: The UserService class directly instantiates MySQLDatabase, making it dependent on a specific database implementation rather than an abstract interface.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use dependency injection to pass the database dependency to the UserService class, allowing for greater flexibility and testability since you can easily switch out the implementation.
